slot.brief: Two statements (e.g., all A are B, some B are C) with four conclusion options including a 'possibility' conclusion; ask which conclusions follow.

stem:
**Statements:**
All kites are toys.
Some toys are made of paper.

**Conclusions:**
I. Some paper items are toys.
II. Some kites being made of paper is a possibility.

verdicts.working: Some toys are paper, so some paper items are toys (I). A kite-paper overlap is consistent with both statements, so II is possible.

working:
Some toys are made of paper, so some paper items are toys: I follows.
No statement excludes kites from the paper-made toys, so their overlap is possible: II follows.

Independent check: Some toys are paper, so some paper items are toys (I). A kite-paper overlap is consistent with both statements, so II is possible.
solution:
Some toys are made of paper; hence, some paper items are toys, so I follows.
No statement rules out kites being among the toys made of paper; therefore, some kites being made of paper is possible, and II follows.
